Non‑alphabetic characters would be left unchanged (none appear in the samples).

The only apparent discrepancy is the pair  
`Lithodidae → Orgslwrwzv`; the Atbash of “Lithodidae” is “Orgslwrwvz”.  
The sample output swaps the last two letters, which is most likely a typographical error.  
Implementing a pure Atbash mapping reproduces every other pair exactly, so the rule is the Atbash cipher.
